title: Subtree of Another Tree
prompt:
Return whether `subRoot` appears as a subtree of `root` — some node of `root` together with all its descendants is identical to `subRoot`.

**Example**: `root = [3,4,5,1,2]`, `subRoot = [4,1,2]` → `true`.

At each node of `root`, test 'is the subtree here identical to subRoot?' using the Same Tree helper.
hints: Empty subRoot is trivially a subtree; if root is null but subRoot isn't, it's not.
At each root node, check `same(root, subRoot)`; if not, recurse into root.left OR root.right.
Reuse the Same Tree comparison as a helper.

solution.explanation: O(m·n) worst case (an identity check at each of m root nodes against the n-node pattern). Every candidate anchor in `root` gets a full structural comparison; the first exact match wins.
